description: A ViewModel class for managing address book data, including loading, adding, editing, deleting, and setting default addresses, with state management and notification capabilities.

classes.name: AddressBookViewModel
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that serves as a ViewModel for address book operations, managing internal state and notifying listeners on changes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of addresses, initializing the address list or seeding if empty, with loading state and error handling.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new address to the repository and refreshes the address list, returning success status.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Edits an existing address in the repository and updates the address list, returning success status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an address by ID from the repository and refreshes the address list.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets an address as default by ID and updates the address list.

methods.name: clearError
methods.description: Clears any existing error message and notifies listeners.
